one_line: Sufi warrior-leader of Awadh who helped trigger the siege of the Lucknow Residency in 1857.

appearance.age_look: early 40s, lean but strong, upright bearing
appearance.face: oval face, medium-brown Awadhi complexion, sharp nose, neatly trimmed black mustache and short beard around jawline, intense focused eyes with dark circles hinting at long campaigns, default expression calm but resolute with a slight frown of concentration
appearance.hair: black hair, kept short and mostly hidden beneath a tall white cotton turban wrapped in multiple smooth folds, with a narrow dark green cloth band wound once near the base like a simple Sufi-style pagri accent
appearance.costume: knee-length plain white cotton kurta with a straight round neckline and long fitted sleeves, over it a dark green wool angarkha-style overcoat crossing left over right and tied at the side, reaching just below the knees with a subtle narrow gold piping along the edges; loose off-white cotton churidar trousers with fine wrinkles at the calves, tucked into mid-calf brown leather riding boots; at the waist a wide maroon cotton kamarband sash wrapped twice and knotted to the left, from which hangs a small leather pouch; over his shoulders a light beige cotton chadar draped from the left shoulder across the back and caught at the right arm, practical for travel and prayer; minimal jewellery—simple silver ring on his right hand and a plain wooden tasbih (prayer beads) looped around his left wrist.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved talwar with a steel blade, brass hilt and disc pommel carried in a brown leather scabbard with brass fittings, slung from his sash on the left hip, his right hand often resting lightly on the hilt.

ref_desc: Ahmadullah Shah is a lean, medium-brown man in a white kurta, dark green angarkha coat, maroon sash, beige chadar, brown boots, white turban with green band, and a brass-hilt talwar at his left hip in a brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Ahmadullah Shah of Faizabad: a lean, medium-brown man in his early forties with an oval face, sharp nose, intense eyes, and a neatly trimmed black mustache with short beard, wearing a tall white cotton turban accented by a narrow dark green band. Show his era-accurate 1857 Awadh outfit clearly: a knee-length plain white cotton kurta under a dark green wool angarkha-style overcoat that crosses left over right and has subtle gold piping, loose off-white churidar trousers with wrinkles at the calves, and mid-calf brown leather riding boots. Wrap a wide maroon cotton kamarband sash around his waist with a small leather pouch hanging, and drape a light beige cotton chadar from his left shoulder across his back. Include his simple silver ring and wooden prayer beads on his wrist. His signature weapon, a slightly curved talwar with a steel blade and brass hilt with disc pommel, rests in a brown leather scabbard with brass fittings at his left hip, with his right hand lightly touching the hilt. Use white, dark green, maroon, brown leather, and beige as dominant colors, and present him from multiple angles in the same outfit to emphasize consistent face, turban, clothing details, and sword placement.
